accepted_meaning: AIDE can deterministically inspect a pinned, already-present Dominium repository through an offline read-only seam and project validated host, capability, workspace, context, artifact, diagnostic, refusal, evidence, event, and bridge records without invoking Dominium commands or mutating Dominium.
forbidden_interpretations: AIDE and Dominium have a live runtime bridge.
warnings: The seam remains offline and read-only.
Pinned local Dominium is behind remote origin/main.
Non-Windows platforms were not separately executed.
Minimum Python 3.11 was not separately executed.
